```{r}
# this code chunk should be copied everywhere
library(tidyverse)
# loading in data
sal <- read_csv(paste0(
  "https://stat.cmu.edu/~sgallagh/courses/mads-fall-2026/",
  "datavis-36613/data/salaries.csv.gz"
))
sal$experience_level <- factor(
  sal$experience_level,
  levels = c("EX", "SE", "MI", "EN"),
  labels = c("Executive", "Senior", "Mid", "Entry")
)
sal <- sal |> 
  mutate(
    remote = case_when(
      remote_ratio == 0 ~ "On-Site",
      remote_ratio == 50 ~ "Hybrid",
      remote_ratio == 100 ~ "Fully remote"
    ), 
    remote = factor(
      remote, levels = c("On-Site", "Hybrid", "Fully remote")
    )
  )
sal <- sal |> 
  filter(employment_type == "FT") |> mutate(log_salary = log(salary_in_usd))
```
